title: CFD Run Ledger Record v1
description: Coordinator-side ledger row for one CFD run (GET /api/cfd/runs, GET /api/cfd/runs/{run_id}). The streaming job store is the authority for the run itself; the ledger holds the pointer, the status projection and the counters the UI lists. The status vocabulary in $defs.status is shared with cfd-run-result-v1 and must not diverge.

origin.description: S7: where and with which parameters the run was submitted, kept so the run stays legible after its review session is closed. Absent/null for runs created before the field existed.

preset_match.description: S8: 'standard' when the streaming service found the effective settings equal to the verified standard preset; null when custom or unknown.

oneOf.description: S8 adds the submitted terrain/true-north settings and the preset match; settings phase B adds the submitted domain and mesh layout fields (all optional, additive).

queue_position.description: S7: 1-based position among queued runs, estimated by the coordinator from ledger created_at (the streaming single-worker FIFO is the authority); null unless the run is queued.

findings.description: S6 A1 finding: governance issues the coordinator opened from this run through the existing /api/issues (annotation kind, no ifc_guid). Absent when none.
